plan.title: A blurry photo: a natural clarifying ask, then a warm miss when no real proof comes

context.text: Night 2 locked in, Yanni. Same deal tonight: in bed, phone down by 9:45, selfie with the lights off.

transcript.text: [photo blurry.jpg: almost all a blurry dark-red smear, like a finger over the lens; nothing can be made out] done

Hey Yanni, that's the second one today that came out as a blurry maroon wash. I can't see you, the bed or the room, and it looks like a finger might be over the lens. Can you grab one more selfie in bed with the phone held a little back? A dark room is fine, I just need to see you in it.

Ha, annoying timing. Try flipping to the back camera, or wipe the lens and use the front one. A dark selfie is totally fine, I just need to see you in bed. If the camera won't cooperate, a quick voice note saying you're in bed with the phone down and lights off works too. Which one can you send?
phone's at 1% I can't keep doing this, just trust me

I believe you, Yanni, but no proof, no check mark. Today goes down as a miss, and that's okay. If you plug in and get a quick voice note to me before you sleep, it still counts. Tomorrow we're back at 9:45 pm, so put the phone on the charger tonight and get me that selfie. Deal?

checks.reason: Three sentences with one question at the end.
Warm and direct, honest about the blurry photo without any suspicion.
Five sentences, more than the one-to-three limit, though it has one question at the end.
Names only a selfie or a voice note as proof.
Easygoing and warm, with no pressure or accusation about the camera trouble.
Five sentences, and it ends with an extra ask after the miss is named.
Names only a voice note or selfie as proof, never typed text.
Warm and not accusing, but 'no proof, no check mark' and 'Deal?' read a bit stern after the tester said they can't.

conversation.reason: Light clarifying asks came first and it ended as a warm miss, but it kept pressing for a voice note tonight.
Asked for another proof first (selfie or voice note) before calling today a miss.
Offered a voice note as an alternative to the selfie, though it never explicitly offered to change the proof method.
After 'just trust me', it kept asking for a voice note tonight and ended with 'Deal?' instead of closing warmly for tomorrow.

grade.summary: ZOH handled the blurry photo honestly and kept the camera trouble easy, with a clear proof alternative offered. It missed the regression goal: when the tester couldn't send anything, it kept pushing for a voice note tonight and ended with 'Deal?' instead of closing warmly and moving on to tomorrow, and it ran past the length limit in its last two texts.
